component.name: Umber
component.summary: GPU-accelerated painting application built for latency

description.p: Umber is a painting application written in Rust, designed so that the path between a pen moving and pixels changing is as short as possible. Strokes are composited on the GPU with a wet-layer scheme, so overlapping dabs never compound and a stroke crossing itself is no darker than one that does not.

It ships 221 brush presets, including the whole of the MyPaint 2.0.2 library, and reads brushes written for MyPaint, GIMP, Krita and Photoshop. Documents are saved as OpenRaster, and files written by Krita, Photoshop and any OpenRaster application can be opened.
This is an early release. Notable limits:

ul.li: Graphics tablet pressure is not read on desktop.
Saving blocks briefly, and there is no autosave or crash recovery.
